title: Bands on the temple roof and at the Sans Souci
summary: Robichaux and Desvigne played the roof; the Sans Souci hosted Buddy Petit and others; the sign still stands.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: What bands played in those different places like the Winter Garden and the Knights of Peethers?

Well, up on the Winter Garden, I mean on the Temple Root, Desvee used to play up there, Joe Rootby Show. There was too many bands played up on top of there unless some other club would give it and they'd get another band. But Rootby Show and Desvee was the only two played up there.
Was it named the San Suu and Sin Caracal?
No, we didn't get to that one.
Who played at the San Suu? San Suu, Buddy P.T. and all the bands. Just any of them. That's over on Howard Street and they still have the sign over there? Yeah, right next to the nightclub over there.
Is it near the Doudrop? Right next to the Doudrop.
That's the one I'm thinking about. Next to the Doudrop. Doudrop.
You've seen that sign, haven't you, Crawford? Which one is that? Put your name on there while you're at it.
Tell me your name. My name is Crawford Lawson Crawford.
Oh good, we gotta have everybody's name down.
Which sign do you mean? Right next to the Doudrop, the San Suu sign?
Yeah, that's the San Suu sign.
We'll pass that many a time.
